import Mathlib

structure DFSGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def DFSGraph.well_formed (g : DFSGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def DFSGraph.size (g : DFSGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def DFSGraph.has_edge (g : DFSGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def DFSGraph.is_path (g : DFSGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def DFSGraph.reachable (g : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dfs_check_reachability_precond (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧ start < graph.size ∧ target < graph.size
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- Neighbours of `u` as a list. -/
def DFSGraph.nbrs (g : DFSGraph) (u : Nat) : List Nat := (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList

/-- Iterative depth-first search.  `rem` is the set of nodes that have not been
visited yet, `st` is the DFS stack. -/
def dfsLoop (g : DFSGraph) (target : Nat) (rem : Finset Nat) (st : List Nat) : Bool :=
  match st with
  | [] => false
  | u :: st' =>
      if u = target then true
      else if h : u ∈ rem then
        dfsLoop g target (rem.erase u) (g.nbrs u ++ st')
      else
        dfsLoop g target rem st'
termination_by (rem.card, st.length)
decreasing_by
  · exact Prod.Lex.left _ _ (Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem h)
  · exact Prod.Lex.right _ (by simp)

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def dfs_check_reachability (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : dfs_check_reachability_precond graph start target) : Bool :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  dfsLoop graph target (Finset.range graph.size) [start]
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dfs_check_reachability_postcond (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat) (result : Bool)
    (_ : dfs_check_reachability_precond graph start target) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result = graph.reachable start target
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

theorem DFSGraph.mem_nbrs_iff {g : DFSGraph} {u v : Nat} :
    v ∈ g.nbrs u ↔ v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] := by
  simp [DFSGraph.nbrs]

theorem DFSGraph.nbrs_eq_nil {g : DFSGraph} {u : Nat} (h : ¬ u < g.adj.size) :
    g.nbrs u = [] := by
  simp [DFSGraph.nbrs, Array.getD, h]

theorem DFSGraph.has_edge_of_mem_nbrs {g : DFSGraph} {u w : Nat} (h : w ∈ g.nbrs u) :
    g.has_edge u w := by
  refine ⟨?_, DFSGraph.mem_nbrs_iff.mp h⟩
  by_contra hlt
  rw [DFSGraph.nbrs_eq_nil hlt] at h
  simp at h

theorem DFSGraph.mem_nbrs_of_has_edge {g : DFSGraph} {u w : Nat} (h : g.has_edge u w) :
    w ∈ g.nbrs u :=
  DFSGraph.mem_nbrs_iff.mpr h.2

theorem DFSGraph.reach_self (g : DFSGraph) (t : Nat) : g.reachable t t := by
  refine ⟨[t], ⟨by simp, ?_⟩, by simp, by simp⟩
  intro i hi
  simp at hi

theorem DFSGraph.path_tail {g : DFSGraph} {x y : Nat} {t : List Nat}
    (hp : g.is_path (x :: y :: t)) : g.is_path (y :: t) ∧ g.has_edge x y := by
  obtain ⟨-, hedge⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨⟨by simp, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    have h2 := hedge (i + 1) (by simp at hi ⊢; omega)
    simpa [List.getD_cons_succ] using h2
  · have h0 := hedge 0 (by simp)
    simpa [List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ] using h0

theorem DFSGraph.path_cons {g : DFSGraph} {u w : Nat} {t : List Nat}
    (he : g.has_edge u w) (hp : g.is_path (w :: t)) : g.is_path (u :: w :: t) := by
  obtain ⟨-, hedge⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  match i with
  | 0 => simpa [List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ] using he
  | (j + 1) =>
      have hi' : j + 1 < (w :: t).length := by simp at hi ⊢; omega
      simpa [List.getD_cons_succ] using hedge j hi'

theorem DFSGraph.reachable_cons {g : DFSGraph} {u w t : Nat} (he : g.has_edge u w)
    (hr : g.reachable w t) : g.reachable u t := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := hr
  cases p with
  | nil => simp at hh
  | cons a s =>
      have haw : a = w := by simpa using hh
      subst haw
      exact ⟨u :: a :: s, DFSGraph.path_cons he hp, by simp, by simpa using hl⟩

theorem DFSGraph.reachable_step {g : DFSGraph} {u t : Nat} (hr : g.reachable u t)
    (hne : u ≠ t) : ∃ w, g.has_edge u w ∧ g.reachable w t := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := hr
  cases p with
  | nil => simp at hh
  | cons x s =>
      have hxu : x = u := by simpa using hh
      subst hxu
      cases s with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          simp at hl
          exact hne hl
      | cons y s' =>
          obtain ⟨hpt, he⟩ := DFSGraph.path_tail hp
          exact ⟨y, he, ⟨y :: s', hpt, by simp, by simpa using hl⟩⟩

theorem DFSGraph.no_reach_closed (g : DFSGraph) (target : Nat) (S : Nat → Prop)
    (hne : ∀ u, S u → u ≠ target)
    (hcl : ∀ u v, S u → v ∈ g.nbrs u → S v) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (u : Nat), g.is_path p → p.head? = some u → S u →
      p.getLast? ≠ some target := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro u _ hh _; simp at hh
  | cons x t ih =>
      intro u hp hh hS
      have hxu : x = u := by simpa using hh
      subst hxu
      cases t with
      | nil => simpa using hne x hS
      | cons y t' =>
          obtain ⟨hpt, he⟩ := DFSGraph.path_tail hp
          have hSy : S y := hcl x y hS (DFSGraph.mem_nbrs_of_has_edge he)
          simpa using ih y hpt (by simp) hSy

theorem DFSGraph.not_reachable_of_closed (g : DFSGraph) (target : Nat) (S : Nat → Prop)
    (hne : ∀ u, S u → u ≠ target)
    (hcl : ∀ u v, S u → v ∈ g.nbrs u → S v) :
    ∀ u, S u → ¬ g.reachable u target := by
  intro u hS hr
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := hr
  exact DFSGraph.no_reach_closed g target S hne hcl p u hp hh hS hl

/-- Loop invariant : every already–visited node is not the target and all of its
successors are either visited or still on the stack. -/
def DFSInv (g : DFSGraph) (target : Nat) (rem : Finset Nat) (st : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u ∉ rem → u ≠ target ∧ ∀ v ∈ g.nbrs u, v ∉ rem ∨ v ∈ st

theorem dfsLoop_nil (g : DFSGraph) (target : Nat) (rem : Finset Nat) :
    dfsLoop g target rem [] = false := by
  rw [dfsLoop]

theorem dfsLoop_cons (g : DFSGraph) (target : Nat) (rem : Finset Nat) (u : Nat)
    (st : List Nat) :
    dfsLoop g target rem (u :: st) =
      if u = target then true
      else if u ∈ rem then dfsLoop g target (rem.erase u) (g.nbrs u ++ st)
      else dfsLoop g target rem st := by
  rw [dfsLoop]
  split <;> simp_all

theorem dfsLoop_sound (g : DFSGraph) (target : Nat) :
    ∀ (c : Nat) (rem : Finset Nat) (st : List Nat), rem.card ≤ c →
      dfsLoop g target rem st = true → ∃ u ∈ st, g.reachable u target := by
  intro c
  induction c with
  | zero =>
      intro rem st hc
      have hrem : rem = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (Nat.le_zero.mp hc)
      subst hrem
      induction st with
      | nil => intro h; rw [dfsLoop_nil] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
      | cons u st' ih =>
          intro h
          rw [dfsLoop_cons] at h
          by_cases hut : u = target
          · subst hut
            exact ⟨u, by simp, DFSGraph.reach_self g u⟩
          · simp only [hut, if_false, Finset.not_mem_empty, if_false] at h
            obtain ⟨w, hw, hr⟩ := ih h
            exact ⟨w, by simp [hw], hr⟩
  | succ c ihc =>
      intro rem st hc
      induction st with
      | nil => intro h; rw [dfsLoop_nil] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
      | cons u st' ih =>
          intro h
          rw [dfsLoop_cons] at h
          by_cases hut : u = target
          · subst hut
            exact ⟨u, by simp, DFSGraph.reach_self g u⟩
          by_cases hmem : u ∈ rem
          · simp only [hut, if_false, hmem, if_true] at h
            have hcard : (rem.erase u).card ≤ c := by
              have h1 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem hmem
              have h2 : 1 ≤ rem.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨u, hmem⟩
              omega
            obtain ⟨w, hw, hr⟩ := ihc _ _ hcard h
            rcases List.mem_append.mp hw with hw1 | hw2
            · exact ⟨u, by simp,
                DFSGraph.reachable_cons (DFSGraph.has_edge_of_mem_nbrs hw1) hr⟩
            · exact ⟨w, by simp [hw2], hr⟩
          · simp only [hut, if_false, hmem, if_false] at h
            obtain ⟨w, hw, hr⟩ := ih h
            exact ⟨w, by simp [hw], hr⟩

theorem dfsLoop_complete (g : DFSGraph) (target : Nat) :
    ∀ (c : Nat) (rem : Finset Nat) (st : List Nat), rem.card ≤ c →
      DFSInv g target rem st → dfsLoop g target rem st = false →
      ∀ u, (u ∈ st ∨ u ∉ rem) → ¬ g.reachable u target := by
  intro c
  induction c with
  | zero =>
      intro rem st hc
      have hrem : rem = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (Nat.le_zero.mp hc)
      subst hrem
      induction st with
      | nil =>
          intro hinv _ u hu
          refine DFSGraph.not_reachable_of_closed g target
            (fun w => w ∉ (∅ : Finset Nat)) ?_ ?_ u ?_
          · intro w hw; exact (hinv w hw).1
          · intro w v hw hv
            rcases (hinv w hw).2 v hv with h1 | h2
            · exact h1
            · simp at h2
          · rcases hu with hu | hu
            · simp at hu
            · exact hu
      | cons u st' ih =>
          intro hinv hfalse
          rw [dfsLoop_cons] at hfalse
          by_cases hut : u = target
          · simp [hut] at hfalse
          · simp only [hut, if_false, Finset.not_mem_empty, if_false] at hfalse
            have hinv' : DFSInv g target ∅ st' := by
              intro w hw
              refine ⟨(hinv w hw).1, ?_⟩
              intro v hv
              exact Or.inl (by simp)
            have := ih hinv' hfalse
            intro w hw
            rcases hw with hw | hw
            · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hw with hw1 | hw2
              · subst hw1
                exact this w (Or.inr (by simp))
              · exact this w (Or.inl hw2)
            · exact this w (Or.inr hw)
  | succ c ihc =>
      intro rem st hc
      induction st with
      | nil =>
          intro hinv _ u hu
          refine DFSGraph.not_reachable_of_closed g target
            (fun w => w ∉ rem) ?_ ?_ u ?_
          · intro w hw; exact (hinv w hw).1
          · intro w v hw hv
            rcases (hinv w hw).2 v hv with h1 | h2
            · exact h1
            · simp at h2
          · rcases hu with hu | hu
            · simp at hu
            · exact hu
      | cons u st' ih =>
          intro hinv hfalse
          rw [dfsLoop_cons] at hfalse
          by_cases hut : u = target
          · simp [hut] at hfalse
          by_cases hmem : u ∈ rem
          · simp only [hut, if_false, hmem, if_true] at hfalse
            have hcard : (rem.erase u).card ≤ c := by
              have h1 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem hmem
              have h2 : 1 ≤ rem.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨u, hmem⟩
              omega
            have hinv' : DFSInv g target (rem.erase u) (g.nbrs u ++ st') := by
              intro w hw
              by_cases hwu : w = u
              · subst hwu
                refine ⟨hut, ?_⟩
                intro v hv
                exact Or.inr (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hv))
              · have hwrem : w ∉ rem := by
                  intro hc'
                  exact hw (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hwu, hc'⟩)
                refine ⟨(hinv w hwrem).1, ?_⟩
                intro v hv
                rcases (hinv w hwrem).2 v hv with h1 | h2
                · exact Or.inl (fun hc' => h1 (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hc'))
                · rcases List.mem_cons.mp h2 with h3 | h4
                  · subst h3
                    exact Or.inl (by simp)
                  · exact Or.inr (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr h4))
            have key := ihc _ _ hcard hinv' hfalse
            intro w hw
            rcases hw with hw | hw
            · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hw with hw1 | hw2
              · subst hw1
                exact key w (Or.inr (by simp))
              · exact key w (Or.inl (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hw2)))
            · exact key w (Or.inr (fun hc' => hw (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hc')))
          · simp only [hut, if_false, hmem, if_false] at hfalse
            have hinv' : DFSInv g target rem st' := by
              intro w hw
              refine ⟨(hinv w hw).1, ?_⟩
              intro v hv
              rcases (hinv w hw).2 v hv with h1 | h2
              · exact Or.inl h1
              · rcases List.mem_cons.mp h2 with h3 | h4
                · subst h3
                  exact Or.inl hmem
                · exact Or.inr h4
            have key := ih hinv' hfalse
            intro w hw
            rcases hw with hw | hw
            · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hw with hw1 | hw2
              · subst hw1
                exact key w (Or.inr hmem)
              · exact key w (Or.inl hw2)
            · exact key w (Or.inr hw)

theorem dfsLoop_init_inv (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (htarget : target < graph.size) :
    DFSInv graph target (Finset.range graph.size) [start] := by
  intro u hu
  have hlt : ¬ u < graph.size := by
    intro h
    exact hu (Finset.mem_range.mpr h)
  refine ⟨fun hc => hlt (hc ▸ htarget), ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  rw [DFSGraph.nbrs_eq_nil (by simpa [DFSGraph.size] using hlt)] at hv
  simp at hv

theorem dfs_key (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : dfs_check_reachability_precond graph start target) :
    (dfsLoop graph target (Finset.range graph.size) [start] = true) ↔
      graph.reachable start target := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, htarget⟩ := h_precond
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hr⟩ :=
      dfsLoop_sound graph target (Finset.range graph.size).card _ _ le_rfl h
    have : u = start := by simpa using hu
    subst this
    exact hr
  · intro hr
    by_contra hne
    have hfalse : dfsLoop graph target (Finset.range graph.size) [start] = false := by
      simpa using hne
    exact dfsLoop_complete graph target (Finset.range graph.size).card _ _ le_rfl
      (dfsLoop_init_inv graph start target htarget) hfalse start (Or.inl (by simp)) hr

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem dfs_check_reachability_postcond_satisfied (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : dfs_check_reachability_precond graph start target) :
    dfs_check_reachability_postcond graph start target
      (dfs_check_reachability graph start target h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold dfs_check_reachability_postcond dfs_check_reachability
  exact propext (dfs_key graph start target h_precond)
  -- !benchmark @end proof

`./check.sh` prints **LEAN VERIFIED** (only warnings: an unused binder, an unused `h_precond`, and two deprecation notices for `Finset.not_mem_empty`).

What I implemented, all inside the four markers:

**auxcode**
- `DFSGraph.nbrs g u` — adjacency list of `u` as a `List Nat`.
- `dfsLoop g target rem st` — the iterative DFS: `rem` is the not-yet-visited set, `st` the stack. Pop `u`; return `true` if it is the target; otherwise if `u` is still unvisited, mark it visited (`rem.erase u`) and push its neighbours; if already visited, just skip it. Termination is by the lexicographic measure `(rem.card, st.length)`: visiting a new node shrinks `rem`, skipping a visited node shrinks the stack — so cycles are handled.

**code**: `dfsLoop graph target (Finset.range graph.size) [start]`.

**lemma** — the verification scaffolding:
- Path plumbing for the `getD`-based `is_path`/`reachable` definitions: `reach_self`, `path_tail`, `path_cons`, `reachable_cons` (prepend an edge), `reachable_step` (a path out of a non-target node goes through a neighbour), plus `has_edge_of_mem_nbrs` / `nbrs_eq_nil` for out-of-range nodes.
- `not_reachable_of_closed`: if a set contains no target and is closed under edges, none of its members reaches the target (induction on the path).
- `DFSInv`: *every visited node is not the target and each of its successors is visited or on the stack*.
- `dfsLoop_sound`: `dfsLoop = true → ∃ u ∈ st, reachable u target`.
- `dfsLoop_complete`: under `DFSInv`, `dfsLoop = false → ∀ u, (u ∈ st ∨ u ∉ rem) → ¬reachable u target`. The empty-stack base case is exactly where the closure argument fires; the invariant is re-established in both recursive cases.
- Both proofs run by outer induction on a bound `c ≥ rem.card` and inner structural induction on the stack, mirroring the lexicographic termination measure.
- `dfsLoop_init_inv`: the initial state satisfies the invariant (nodes outside `range size` have no neighbours and are not the target).

**proof**: `propext` applied to the `↔` from `dfs_key`, since the postcondition is the coerced equality `(result = true) = graph.reachable start target`.

analysis:
The student’s submission does implement an actual DFS-style reachability checker from scratch, and does not appear to use cheating mechanisms.

What the problem requires:
- Implement DFS on a directed graph represented as adjacency lists.
- Return true iff target is reachable from start.
- Prove soundness, completeness, and termination.
- Avoid tricks like `sorry`, `admit`, empty bodies, or outsourcing to pre-verified library search procedures.

What the student implemented:
- A graph structure `DFSGraph` with adjacency array.
- A recursive function `dfsLoop` operating on:
  - `rem : Finset Nat` = unvisited nodes,
  - `st : List Nat` = DFS stack.
- Main function initializes with all nodes unvisited and stack `[start]`.
- At each step:
  - if stack empty => false
  - pop `u`
  - if `u = target` => true
  - else if `u ∈ rem`, mark visited by erasing from `rem`, and push neighbors in front of stack (`g.nbrs u ++ st'`)
  - else skip it

This is a standard iterative graph search with a LIFO worklist behavior consistent with DFS. Using a list as a stack and prepending neighbors to the front is a legitimate DFS implementation.

About semantic alignment with DFS:
- It is not BFS.
- It does not call any built-in reachability/search algorithm.
- It explicitly manages visited/unvisited and a stack.
- The algorithm explores successors depth-first via stack discipline.

About verification content:
- There are substantial lemmas proving path properties and reachability composition.
- There is a loop invariant `DFSInv`.
- There are separate soundness and completeness theorems for `dfsLoop`.
- Termination is handled with a lexicographic measure `(rem.card, st.length)`.

About cheating:
- No `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, or placeholder bodies.
- No empty implementation.
- No suspicious delegation to an existing graph library reachability function.
- The proof and algorithm are developed directly.

Minor note:
- The implementation uses `Finset.range graph.size` as the initial unvisited set, so only valid graph nodes are considered, which matches the intended setup under the precondition.
- The proof structure is nontrivial and clearly aimed at the requested soundness/completeness/termination obligations.

Overall, the student satisfies the natural-language requirement: they implemented and verified a DFS-based reachability checker from scratch without cheating.
